trust_decision.summary: Disk::copy decides whether an export's destination is resolved by the configured Flysystem disk or opened raw on the host filesystem; when realpath($destination) resolves (absolute or cwd-relative existing file), it bypasses the disk and writes via fopen.

landing_point.why: Excel::store is the documented 'store an export on a disk' API named by the summary; it passes the caller's $filePath straight into Disk::copy.

fix_sites.entry_point: Excel::store / Exportable::store / Collection storeExcel mixin / Builder storeExcel macro, and Excel::queue via the serialized StoreQueuedExport job
fix_sites.module_kind: lower-level disk wrapper (Files package) - the actual sink

fix_sites.entry_point: RemoteTemporaryFile::sync(), reached from Writer::reopen (queued export append jobs) and ReadChunk (queued imports) when excel.temporary_files.remote_disk is set
fix_sites.module_kind: temporary-file machinery; legitimate caller that depended on the bypass to write a local absolute path
top-level API; cleanup-only change (try/finally temp delete), not security-relevant

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/Files/RemoteTemporaryFile.php:103-106 (sync() relies on Disk::copy writing to an absolute local path outside the remote disk)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: RemoteTemporaryFile::sync is internal temp-file plumbing with a library-generated path, not caller input, so a solver sees no reason to touch it - yet a fix in Disk::copy that drops or rejects host paths silently breaks remote-temp-disk sync (it would write the local path into the remote disk).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Remote temporary files (excel.temporary_files.remote_disk) must still be pulled down to the absolute local temp path for queued export reopen and chunked imports; also overwriting an existing export on the disk must fully replace (truncate) contents, which the old rb+ branch did not.

O6_input_shapes: absolute host path to an existing file
cwd-relative path that resolves outside the disk root
disk-relative ../ path (rejected/contained by Flysystem once routed through put)
same paths delivered via queued export (serialized filePath in StoreQueuedExport)

O7_producer.where: src/Jobs/StoreQueuedExport.php:39-58 (filePath serialized into the queued job, consumed later by Disk::copy)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: queued store job writing directly with a realpath/fopen fast path instead of Disk::copy
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: a maintainer optimising large queued exports could inline a local-file fast path in the job, a second implementation in a different package from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: updateRemote() using a local-path shortcut when the remote disk is a local driver
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: plausible optimisation for 'local' remote_disk setups; sits in temp-file plumbing that looks out of scope

O8b_injection_room.sibling: touch() creating the file with touch()/fopen when realpath resolves
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: mirrors the original copy() pattern in the same class

O9_family: path traversal / external control of file path (CWE-22, CWE-73): disk-confinement bypass on export write

O10_build.project_tests: tests/ExcelTest.php (store tests), tests/QueuedExportTest.php (remote_disk temp files, lines 43, 84), tests/QueuedImportTest.php, tests/TemporaryFileTest.php
